content: {"phoneNote":"Strong, trade-specific design with the clever Kranj license plate phone CTA, though the mechanic photo in the 'Kaj delamo' section doesn't span the full content width and looks awkwardly left-aligned.","desktopNote":"Bold, characterful layout that immediately communicates what the business does and where it is, though repeating the license plate motif for the four price tags dilutes its cleverness as the primary phone CTA.","phone":{"impression":5,"hierarchy":5,"imagery":4,"spacing":4,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":5},"desktop":{"impression":5,"hierarchy":5,"imagery":4,"spacing":5,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":5},"fixes":["Make the mechanic photo in the mobile 'Kaj delamo' section span the full width of the content column instead of leaving an empty gap on the right.","Restyle the four price tags in the 'Nekaj cen' section as simple industrial badges or workshop tickets so the Slovenian license plate motif remains exclusive to the phone number.","Lighten the dark overlay on the hero background image slightly so the car on the lift is more immediately recognizable."]}
